title: batertf: GPU boundary element code, rigs and tools for bat emission and reception directivities

creators.name: Steckel, Jan
creators.affiliation: Cosys-Lab, University of Antwerp, Belgium; Flanders Make, Lommel, Belgium

description: Code that produced the dataset 'Full-sphere emission and reception directivities of seven echolocating bat species': mesh cleaning, GPU boundary element solver (Burton-Miller), source placement, posable rigs of pinnae and noseleaves, validation, figures, and a Python module and Python/MATLAB examples to use the data.
